{{Quote|Senate Commandos? How does a money-grabbing worm like Gunray rate all this security?|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="COD">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref>}}
'''Senate Commandos''' were an elite [[Division/Legends|division]] in the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] that functioned as [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] for the [[Bodyguard/Legends|protection]] of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and other politicians, but could also be used as security detail for enemies of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], such as [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war. 

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Senate Commandos&mdash;along with the rest of the Senate Guard&mdash;were gradually supplemented and replaced by their [[Red Guard]] counterparts by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Overview==
[[File:SenateGuardCommando-GAW.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Senate Guard and their elite counterpart, the Senate Commando]]
An elite [[Division/Legends|division]] in the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], Senate [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]] were primarily stationed in the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Like the more common guardsmen of their [[organization]], the Commandos were responsible for the protection of the Republic government's [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|executive]] and legislative branches; the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] respectively.<ref name="EncyclopediaSG" /> Their duties included guarding various rooms and offices within the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]<ref name="SSpy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref> and its counterpart, the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]].<ref name="HC" /> They also specialized in carrying out field missions on behalf of the Senate and the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]].<ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> They often used [[Massiff/Legends|massiff]] with some of the missions they were handed. Their high profile status afforded them top priority assignments, as noted by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] when a [[unit]] of Senate Commandos was dispatched to guard the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].<ref name="COD" />

The Senate Commandos&mdash;reputedly the best and bravest [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the Senate Guard&mdash;were composed of guardsmen noted for excellent service records, thus making them eligible for high risk mission profiles.<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> Some of their off-world assignments consisted of protecting [[Senator/Legends|senators]], [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] and other representatives of the Galactic Senate during diplomatic voyages to other planets; guarding Republic [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that carried elected or appointed officials, such as Senator [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] or [[Duke/Legends|Dutchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]];<ref name="VOG">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref> and accompanying the Supreme Chancellor when ever he left Coruscant.<ref name="CrisisOnNaboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>

In order to qualify for membership, a recruit had to pass through a brutal four week-long period of additional combat training. After being elevated to their new rank, Senate Commandos were deployed into a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] where they reported to a [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. They also deferred to the authority of the individual under their protection, except in situations that involved the person's security.<ref name="GAW" />

[[File:Argyus Departure.png|thumb|right|250px|A squad of Senate Commandos led by Captain Argyus on Coruscant.]]
On Coruscant, the Senate Commandos&mdash;along with the rest of the Guard&mdash;served as the elite security force of the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. While the rank-and-file members of the Senate Guard were normally used for ceremonial functions, the Commandos served in a more practical capacity.<ref name="EncyclopediaSG" /> Hence, they were often dispatched to detain individuals who were wanted for questioning by the Galactic Senate;<ref name="COD" /> or otherwise deployed into war zones where they acted as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] to Republic senators.<ref name="AFIN">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref> As a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]], they maintained law and order on Coruscant alongside [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]], [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]<ref name="DOM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="GAW" /> Overall, position in the ranks of the Senate Commandos was regarded as a source of pride to its members, thus making them one of the most cherished traditions of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="SW:TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

[[File:Ordonance disposal droid.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Senate Commandos maintained security on Coruscant, sometimes working alongside Ordanance disposal and the Coruscant Guard.]]
Senate Commandos were equipped with far more functional [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that did not include the heavy robes or symbolic feather plums that adorned the more common members of the Senate Guard.<ref name="EncyclopediaSG" /> They were a practical force of soldiers suited for combat,<ref name="SW:TCWCE" /> and thus their armor was similar to the [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I battle armor]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. Despite the aesthetic resemblance, Senate Commando armor differed from [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] armor in color and helmet design. The Commandos' armor also featured an enlarged left [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] that was resistant to [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire; its primary color was blue, the trademark shade of the entire Senate Guard.<ref name="COD" /> By discarding the heavy ceremonial robes of the Guard, Senate Commandos were capable of fighting more effectively in combat scenarios.<ref name="CWCG" /> The Commando battle suit was a flexible, customizable form of field armor that protected its wearers in hostile situations.<ref name="GAW" /> Commando officers, such as [[Captain/Legends|captains]], wore helmets with ceremonial crests; their blue armor incorporated white symbolic designs such as the [[Galactic Great Seal|Seal]] of the Galactic Senate.<ref name="HC">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref> Furthermore, Senate Commandos were issued identification numbers, such as [[SG-1984/Legends|SG-1984]], for security purposes.<ref name="CrisisOnNaboo" />

Another aspect that separated the Commandos from the rest of the Senate Guard was their weaponry. While their more formal contemporaries were armed with [[Mk II Paladin blaster rifle/Legends|ceremonial]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]],<ref name="SWEI">{{Film|I}}</ref> the Senate Commandos were armed with the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]],<ref name="COD" /> and a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal]] [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]],<ref name="GAW" /> all of which were used by clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]].<ref name="EncyclopediaCT">{{SWE|groups|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref>

Unlike the clone-filled [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], Senate Commandos&mdash;along with their Senate Guard contemporaries and [[Red Guard]] counterparts&mdash;were formed of birth-born [[Human/Legends|Human]] volunteers.<ref name="GAW" /><ref name="SW:TCWCE" /><ref name="EncyclopediaArgyus">{{SWE|characters|argyus|Captain Argyus}}</ref> As one of the Republic's few non-clone units to be deployed regularly on special assignments, the Senate Commandos developed a fierce rivalry with the Grand Army's [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]].<ref name="CWCG" />

==History==
[[File:Senate_Commandos_Hostage_Crisis.png|thumb|right|250px|Captain Jayfon and his men guarding the Republic Executive Building]]
Both the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] and the government of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had been protected by the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] for hundreds of years; its best and bravest [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] rewarded with position in the ranks of the Senate Commandos.<ref name="EncyclopediaSG" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Commandos were serving as [[Bodyguard/Legends|protectors]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="GAW" /> Hence, they were often stationed on guard duties within certain chambers and facilities belonging to the Chancellor, such as his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]] at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]],<ref name="SW:TCW" /> although some of its most loyal members were incorporated into the [[Red Guard]] as well.<ref name="GAW" />

When [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], was captured and detained by Republic authorities,<ref name="BombadJedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Faro Argyus/Legends|Faro Argyus]] and a group of Senate Commandos were dispatched to oversee the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian's]] transfer to Coruscant. Given Gunray's dealings with the [[Order of the Sith Lords]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] were unwilling to allow the Neimoidian to remain in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] custody. Therefore, Dooku deployed a [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] named [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to either retrieve or [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Gunray before the Jedi broke his silence through interrogation. After infiltrating the [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']], a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] where Gunray was held captive, Ventress killed numerous clone troopers and several Senate Commandos while trying to free her target. Ultimately Gunray's escape succeeded due to the treachery of Captain Argyus. Bribed with promises of freedom and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|wealth]] by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], Argyus broke his allegiance to the Republic and aided in Gunray's escape, [[Death/Legends|killing]] his fellow Senate Commandos in the process.<ref name="COD" />

After Argyus's betrayal of the Republic,<ref name="COD" /> Captain [[Jayfon/Legends|Jayfon]] and a large contingent of Commandos were killed while on guard duty at the Republic Executive Building by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. A [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|hostage crisis]] followed immediately after their deaths, in which several senators were held captive as part of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]' plot to free [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]].<ref name="HC" />

[[File:CoronetCommandos.png|thumb|left|250px|Senate Commandos aboard the ''Coronet'']]
Four Senate Commandos were stationed aboard the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] vessel [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] as bridge crew under the command of Captain [[Gray (Coronet captain)/Legends|Gray]]. They were taken by surprise and killed by [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] Senator [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]], a secret [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[operative]] who attempted to abduct [[Duke/Legends|Dutchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. The Dutchess was rescued by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Merrik was killed,<ref name="VOG" /> though she was later framed for murder on Coruscant, thus leading to her arrest warrant. Aided by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Kryze allowed two Senate Commandos to arrest her. Kenobi used the distraction to infiltrate the Senate Building where he provided Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] with evidence to exonerate the Dutchess.<ref name="DOM" />


A group of Senate Commandos served as bodyguards to Chancellor Palpatine and [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] while the two inspected the captured [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] that was brought to Coruscant from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. When the creature escaped from its bonds and rampaged through [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], Palpatine was evacuated to a [[H-2 executive shuttle/Legends|H-2 executive shuttle]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a [[Unidentified Senate Commando (Zillo Beast incident)/Legends|single Commando]]. The Zillo Beast disabled the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], forcing the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to save Chancellor Palpatine. The Senate Commando was crushed to death by the Zillo Beast, immediately after he implored the Chancellor to escape to safety.<ref name="Zillo">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>

[[File:Unidentified Senate Commando Coruscant platform.png|thumb|right|250px|The Senate Commandos were eventually phased out by Palpatine's Red Guard and later the Stormtrooper Corps.]]
When Chancellor Palpatine made a scheduled visit to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] for the upcoming [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]], a large security force&mdash;consisting of [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] and Senate Guard commandos&mdash;accompanied him due to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council's]] concern for his safety. One of the Commandos responsible for guarding the Chancellor was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] designated as [[SG-1984/Legends|SG-1984]].<ref name="CrisisOnNaboo" />

The Senate Commandos were eventually phased out, along with the rest of the Senate Guard, in the aftermath of the Republic's transformation into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], Palpatine's security was entrusted to the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guard]]. The enforcement of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] on Coruscant fell to the Emperor's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="EncyclopediaSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', revealed that the Senate Commandos were inspired by [[Wikipedia:Ancient Rome|Ancient Rome's]] [[Wikipedia:Praetorian Guard|Praetorian Guards]]. Therefore, the paint scheme for Captain Jayfon was a mixture of Roman décor and ''[[Star Wars]]'' graphics.<ref name="Art of SW:TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>
